groups.saying_opens: ليست نفس مخلوقة إلا الله خالقها

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a): the Mustaliq captives and the withdrawal question, and the «وقال مجاهد عن قزعة» saying.
«موسى هو ابن عقبة» is an editor's gloss: left out. The «موضع تعليق» style of a suspended chain in the second saying is read as written.
